_source: Pinellas County Land Development Code, Chapter 138, Article IV — Landscape Standards
_note: Data is a structured summary for reference. Verify against current code before use.

perimeter_buffers._description: Required landscape buffer widths (feet) based on adjacent land use/zoning. Sec. 138-4503.

residential_to_residential.notes: Type A buffer: 1 tree per 25 lf, 1 shrub per 3 lf

nonresidential_to_residential.notes: Type B buffer: 1 tree per 25 lf, 2 shrubs per 3 lf, 6-ft opaque screen

industrial_to_residential.notes: Type C buffer: 1 tree per 25 lf, 3 shrubs per 3 lf, 6-ft opaque screen

parking_lot_landscaping._description: Interior parking lot landscaping requirements. Sec. 138-4505.

interior_islands.notes: One terminal island at end of each row; one interior island per 10 continuous spaces

shade_requirement.notes: 50% canopy coverage of parking area at 10-year maturity

tree_requirements._description: Tree preservation and replacement requirements. Sec. 138-4507.

minimum_tree_size.notes: Minimum size for newly planted trees

irrigation._description: Irrigation system requirements for new landscape areas. Sec. 138-4509.
irrigation.drought_tolerant_exemption: Areas planted exclusively with drought-tolerant or native species may be exempt after establishment period
irrigation.reclaimed_water: Required where reclaimed water is available within 500 feet
irrigation.rain_sensor: Automatic rain shutoff sensor required on all irrigation systems

stormwater_landscaping._description: Landscape requirements in stormwater facilities. Sec. 138-4511.

littoral_zone.notes: 30% of pond shoreline must have littoral (aquatic) plantings
